title: ORV / Solo Leveling color lock
question: Scenario Broadcast is already locked (void black + system chrome). Which manhwa System color pattern should the whole-app tokens follow?

options.label: ORV System Blue
options.thesis: Keep void ground and ice text; push phosphor toward classic ORV message-box blue; amber stays ON AIR / CTA / alert lamps only.
options.case: Closest to Main Scenario windows; preserves the approved cyan/amber broadcast roles.
options.risk: Reads less Solo Leveling purple than a hunter-gate HUD.

options.label: SL Hunter Violet
options.thesis: Retint system chrome to Solo Leveling violet/magenta glow; ice text and amber CTA lamps stay; coral stays fight-hit only.
options.case: Stronger hunter-System identification on Draft and fight.
options.risk: Fights the locked Scenario Broadcast cyan crawl and approved dual-seat comp.

options.label: Fusion Blue + Violet
options.thesis: ORV blue owns borders/crawl/system chrome; SL violet owns god seals, epic rarity, and secondary accents; amber stays CTA/alert.
options.case: Honors the prior full-app fusion choice without inventing a new world.
options.risk: Two accents can muddy hierarchy unless violet stays scarce.
